description: The slot shape of stored Scene documents: a slot's role, the primary slot, upgrading a document from the outlet shape Scene 5 replaced (upgradeSlotShape / SlotShapeUpgrader) and validating the slot shape on save (validateSlotShape / SlotShapeValidator). Asserted by the TypeScript and C# engines.
hint: Scene 5 replaced outlets with slots: upgrade the document (upgradeSlotShape, or SlotShapeUpgrader in C#), or run `screenplay migrate --from 5 --to 6` on its Screenplay source

roles.name: a declared role in another letter case
a primary slot without a role is a page
any other slot without a role is a pane
a declared role wins over primary

primary.name: the first of several marked primary

upgrades.name: a layout's outlets become routed slots
an existing slot keeps its own values
a slot the user made unrouted stays unrouted
a null on an outlet is never copied, and a null the slot has stays
a null on a slot is absent, so the outlet's value fills it
a kind of outlet on something that is not a destination stays
values a user typed in an element's properties stay, apart from destinations
a template with outlets and no slots
the primary outlet becomes the primary slot
metadata holding only the primary outlet is dropped
a destination's outlet and kind become slot
a destination kind written by a C# host keeps its letter case
a destination naming the same outlet and slot keeps one
a nested outlet a screen declares becomes a nested slot
a whole document
a document already in the slot shape comes back unchanged
outlets of items are not the outlet shape
an outlet key on something that is not a destination stays
a primary outlet that is not a slot stays and is reported

upgrades.name: a feature toolbar becomes a refinement that extends the toolbar outlet
a module toolbar joins the refinements the module already has
a template that declares outlets of items is already in the outlet shape
navigation regions become outlets of navigation, their buttons outlets of actions and module regions refinements
a navigation model in the outlet shape is left as it is
navigation items contributed to a contribution point become a contribution to the outlet of navigation, ordered
grouped navigation contributions become sub-items of an item named after the group
an action component's presentation becomes opens
an action presentation that cannot become opens is reported and kept

diagnostics.message: The action 'odd' is presented as 'popover', which is not none, modal or drawer, so it has no opens to become
The action 'torn' is presented as 'drawer' but opens 'dialog'; keep one

a toolbar element that names no outlet becomes the toolbar outlet
a toolbar element whose item passes parameters to its command is reported and kept

diagnostics.message: The toolbar 'bar' has the item 'edit' that passes parameters to its command, which an outlet button takes from the slice's inputs instead, so it is kept as it is

upgrades.name: a toolbar element whose items say what they show keep it as the display of their buttons, with other hints dropped and reported

navigation regions leave out what is not a list of objects and keep the rest of the application
navigation items contributed with a value that is not text, or without the label or the screen, stay

navigation contributions join the outlet contributions the screen already has

navigation contributions take the destination only when it is an object and the bindings only when they say something
grouped navigation contributions keep the first position of their group, apart from the items without a group
navigation contributions are found in every nested object that has them
